newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed in brisker trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed in brisker trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Friday in brisker trade.
* Of 11 active issues five were up, two down and four remained flat.
* Volume tripled to 15,865 shares, turnover 10.6 million kuna.
* The biggest gainer was Zagrebacka Banka 2C-series, closing at 600 kuna, up from 480 on Wednesday.
* The biggest loser was Zagrebacka ordinary stock, down 99 kuna to 1601 on volume of 3,149 shares.
* The most active issue was food producer Podravka with 6,405 shares traded. It closed ten kuna up at 274.
